_why: 2026-08-02, security scan finding (HIGH x2). Flow ships two native binaries it
does not build: the whisper speech engine and WinKeyServer.exe, the process that
watches every keystroke on the machine. Both were fetched from third-party GitHub
repositories with NO integrity check at all, and one of them resolved 'latest'
rather than a pinned tag.
The attack was not hypothetical and it did not need Flow to be compromised at all.
Someone who took over the upstream account publishes a trojaned asset; the next
time a v* tag is pushed here, CI downloads it, packages it, and - this is the part
that stings - the build-provenance attestation added the day before faithfully
signs the result as a genuine Flow build. Every install auto-updates. The malicious
binary is then spawned as the speech engine, or IS the keyboard hook.
Pinning a VERSION is not enough on its own: GitHub lets a release asset be replaced
in place, so a tag names a file, never its bytes. Only a hash names the bytes.
TO UPDATE ONE OF THESE: change the version, run scripts/verify-native-deps.cjs
--print to get the new hashes, and commit them in the SAME change. A hash bump
without a version bump, or the reverse, is what this file exists to make visible
in a diff.
2026-08-04, PORTAGE macOS : deux assets de plus, au MEME tag epingle que leurs
equivalents Windows (whisper 0.0.8, llama b10234). Leurs empreintes ont ete
calculees en telechargeant les fichiers depuis ces tags-la, pas recopiees d'une
page : le raisonnement du bandeau ci-dessus s'applique identiquement a macOS, et
un binaire Mac non verifie serait la meme porte ouverte sous un autre nom.
P9 (2026-08-02). Le TROISIEME binaire natif tiers de ce produit, apres
whisper-server et WinKeyServer. Il recoit le transcript ENTIER d'une reunion
pour la resumer, donc il merite exactement la discipline que la campagne de
securite de ce matin a posee pour les deux autres : empreinte commitee,
verifiee AVANT extraction. (La suite de cette phrase promettait une empreinte
de l executable extrait : voir _extracted_why, une mesure l a rendue inutile.)
MESURE, pas deduite : llama-server b10234 build Vulkan, avec
Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct-Q4_K_M, a produit de vraies notes de reunion en 8,9 s
en laissant 11,1 Go de VRAM libres.
_extracted_why: D1 (2026-08-03). PAS d empreinte d executable extrait ici, contrairement a
keyspy, et la raison est une mesure : llama-server.exe ne pese que 9 Ko. C est
un lanceur mince ; tout le code qui lit le transcript vit dans 53 DLL a cote.
Figer l empreinte du seul .exe serait une decoration : elle laisserait passer
un remplacement de ggml-vulkan.dll, qui est ou le travail se fait vraiment.
Ce qui protege ici est donc l empreinte de l ARCHIVE, verifiee AVANT
extraction par fetch-llama.cjs. Elle couvre les 54 fichiers d un coup.
Empreinte de l archive VERIFIEE contre le vrai fichier le 2026-08-03 : 32,5 Mo
telecharges, sha256 identique. Elle avait ete epinglee par P9 sans jamais etre
confrontee au fichier.
2026-08-02, security scan F7 (MEDIUM). Pinning the ARCHIVE was not enough,
for a reason the finding named and the disk confirmed: keyspy's own
postinstall usually extracts and removes the .tar.gz, so on a real dev
machine the archive is ABSENT and there is nothing left to check. The exe
that watches every keystroke on this computer was sitting in node_modules
vouched for by nobody.
So the hash below is of the EXTRACTED binary, which is what actually runs.
It covers both routes into runtime/: keyspy's own extraction and ours.
PROVENANCE OF THIS NUMBER, since a hash nobody can re-derive is a decoration:
the pinned archive was downloaded, matched against the archive hash above,
extracted, and WinKeyServer.exe hashed from those verified bytes. The copy
already installed here was byte-identical. Re-derive it the same way with
To re-derive: download the pinned archive, check it against the archive hash
above, unpack it, hash the exe. Confirm a local copy with:
node scripts/verify-native-deps.cjs --extracted keyspy <path to the exe>
(The flag named here before this line was rewritten did not exist - caught by
an adverse review, in the very file that says an un-re-derivable hash is a
decoration.)
